auth.welcomeText: Sign in to continue to your account.

forgot.headline: Forgot your password?
forgot.headlineText: It happens. We will email you a link to choose a new one.
forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter the email address of your account
forgot.sentText: If an account exists for {email}, we have sent a link to reset the password. Nothing arrived? Check the spam folder, or try again in a few minutes.

reset.headline: Choose a new password
reset.headlineText: Pick one you do not use anywhere else.
reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Type it twice to be sure it is right
reset.incompleteText: Open the link from the email again, or ask for a new one.
reset.newPasswordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number
reset.changed: Password changed. Log in with the new password.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.placeholder: This is a placeholder page. Build your app's home page here.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: Your account details
profile.name: Name
profile.sessionsText: Logged in somewhere you no longer use, or lost a device? End every session.
profile.logoutAllText: You will be logged out everywhere, including this device. Other devices are logged out within a few minutes.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Everyone who can log in
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, username or email
users.name: Name

connection.databaseText: The server is running but cannot reach its database. Please try again in a moment.

errors.crashText: This page could not be displayed. Reloading usually fixes it.
errors.notFoundText: Sorry, the page you visited does not exist.
